|---|---|
| **HDX HAPI timeout** | Set to `45s` for food-price endpoint, `30s` for food-security and population |

| **No retry logic** | Zero retry logic anywhere — one failure = permanent error for that request |
| **Domain blocking** | Non-agriculture queries hard-fail with HTTP 400 — intentional but inflexible |
| **PDF search timeout risk** | `searchInDocuments()` sends full document text (up to 2000 chars × N docs) to GPT-4o — no timeout set on this call |
